text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today as well, Sakura Bakushin O was 
giving her all at the front gate with her 
"Greeting Bakushin Campaign."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: !! Good moooorning!!
choice_data_list:
Good morning, working hard today too, I 
see.

Good morning, you're working hard today 
too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, working hard, you say...? Why, of 
course... That goes without saying!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Three Bakushins upon a stone! I have 
already become a master greeter!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Still keeping at it today, I see, Bakushin 
O.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oh, Air Groove-san! Good moooorning!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I came to observe again today. I'll be 
watching how things go from the side.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As someone who gave advice on her 
greetings before, I was curious about her 
progress...! So I decided to observe 
alongside her.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Bourbon-san! Arriving at school at the 
exact same time again today, I see!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative. My activity schedule is 
constantly set to optimal parameters.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo-san! In the end, did Inari-san run 
alongside you yesterday?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Mornin', Bakushin O! It went totally 
perfectly! Hot-blooded, super inspiring, 
and full of motivation!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: ...Ah! You over there! Tsu!!

text_block_list.name: Timid Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
G-Good morning...! Um, you're full of 
energy today as well...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The Class Rep is always brimming with 
energy! Setting that aside, you! If I 
recall correctly, today is your very first 
mock race, right?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hold on! Don't worry, I know! You want a 
cheeeeeer from your Class Rep, don't you?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You can do it! You've got this! You'll 
win!! Time to Bakushin!! Have a great 
day!!

text_block_list.name: Timid Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. Yeah, I think I'm feeling energized 
now...! Thank you, I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Impressive that you remembered all 
that. Everyone's individual arrival times, 
the fact that today was her first mock 
race...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! When you greet people every day, you 
gradually begin to remember everything!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That way, saying "well done!" or 
"amazing!" makes it much easier for me as 
Class Rep to praise everyone, wouldn't you 
say?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I have fun! Everyone gets energized! This 
is truly the best part of greeting!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I've also firmly memorized everyone's 
faces again! Man, Tracen Academy really 
has so many students!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph. It seems the results of the 
"Greeting Bakushin Campaign" are quite 
favorable.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Of course they are! Because with this 
Class Rep's greeting, energy was delivered 
with a Bakushin!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That is also a fine outcome, but what I 
truly noticed... is your personal growth, 
Bakushin O.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Mine?! I thought I was just a Class Rep 
bestowing blessings upon others...?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Fool. Looking closely at each student's 
face, and recognizing them not just as 
"the student body" but as "individuals"—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That is an invaluable and noble lesson for 
someone who leads others... or in your 
words, for a Class Rep.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...You've learned well, Bakushin O.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
In other words... even though I was 
already perfect as Class Rep, I went and 
achieved even further growth!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Greeting lots of people is truly amazing!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Because it's amazing—ah! How could someone 
like me have completely forgotten! Even 
though it's so amazing!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Allow me to say it properly, <username>-san!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Good morning!! Have a wonderful day!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sent off by a refreshing greeting, it felt 
like today was going to be a great day...!
